claims: The Palace of Versailles was the site of Marie Antoinette's ceremonial wedding.
The walking distance between the Palace of Versailles and the Louvre Museum is approximately 18.9 kilometers.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Mondays.
The Louvre Museum is closed on Tuesdays.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM on Wednesdays.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Thursdays.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM on Fridays.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Saturdays.
The Louvre Museum is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Sundays.
